This is the big one! Once you're done drooling over the artwork on this card (created by our expert artists), imagine getting one in every sealed deck game! Add any ability 2 pilot, and you've got a destiny draw. Play with all your TIEs... you're guaranteed to have a way to move them around. The Dreadnaught gives them a power boost, too.

For constructed-deck contests, note that this bruiser is non-unique. It has a little less power than the Victory-class ship, but it's cheaper and has the same forfeit. More than a match for those pesky [[Corellian]] Corvettes, she stands toe-to-toe with the [[Tantive IV]].

Combos:

[[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] + Dreadnaught + 4 TIE Fighters: For a deploy cost of 4, get power 13 and forfeit 13 with ability of 6.

Dreadnaught + [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Vader's Custom TIE]] + [[DS-61-2]] + [[Black 2]] + [[DS-61-3]] + [[Black 3]] + [[DS-61-4]] + [[Black 4]]: Power 28, forfeit 36 and ability 14. There's the real [[Death Star Assault Squadron]], complete with transport vehicle.
